VI.description: Keeps where the remote pointer is over the open LabVIEW popups and what the server did about it (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C Popups) - a functional global: a Feedback Node outside any loop\2C initialized on the first call only\2C so the state survives between calls of this non-reentrant VI (the composer builds no uninitialized shift register). With write? TRUE state in is stored\3B either way state is the stored value. Written by RemoteVI Note Popup Pointer.vi (pointer moves)\2C RemoteVI Popup Click.vi (clicks)\2C RemoteVI Swallow Button Up.vi and RemoteVI Menu Hover.vi (hover highlight and dwell\2C once per server loop iteration). Fields\3A active - a pointer position over the popups waits to be applied\3B x\2C y - that position in LOGICAL screen pixels\3B moved - tick count of the last pointer move\3B navigated - the position has been applied to the menu highlight\3B menu\2C top\2C hit - the menu window the highlight was last moved in\2C the top row of its highlight band (window pixels) and whether the band contains the pointer\3B row since - tick count since when that band is highlighted\3B dwelled - VK_RIGHT has been posted for this dwell\3B plain - a popup window that showed no highlight after VK_DOWN (colour picker\2C line width popup) and is operated with the mouse\3B swallow up - a button-down on a menu was turned into keys\2C so the matching button-up must not be posted. One server loop per LabVIEW instance\2C so one state is enough. Pure G\2C no I/O.

Control.description: The state to store when write? is TRUE.

Indicator.description: The stored state (after storing state in when write? is TRUE).
